candidates.reason: A stronger sparse retriever is relevant, but replacing the transparent lexical baseline during the trial-readiness round would mix retrieval-method evaluation with evidence packaging and add dependency cost without a reviewed target corpus.
Semantic embeddings may help later comparison work, but model downloads, heavier dependencies and unbenchmarked fixture effects violate the clean zero-cost 20-minute default for this round.

adoption_summary: No external code or dependency was adopted. The lexical baseline remains explicit and future adapter work must compare against it.
